content.rendered:
Beginning in March 2024, the Sherwood School District will post electronic report cards for all students to ParentVUE.  Report cards will be delivered in PDF format for ease of viewing and printing at home. As we move to this paperless option, report card delivery to all families will default to “paperless-only,” and paper report cards will no longer be mailed home. If you would like to receive a paper copy of your student’s report card, you must opt out of paperless-only in ParentVUE.

Opting Out of Paperless-Only Report Cards

To opt-out of paperless-only report cards, please follow the steps below:

1. Sign into ParentVUE using either the mobile app or a browser.  If you do not have an account for ParentVUE, please contact the front office of your student’s school to obtain an activation key.

2. Tap “My Account”.  On the mobile app, this item is located at the bottom right.  In a browser, it is located at the top of the screen.

Mobile App:

Browser:

3. If using the mobile app, tap “Notify” at the top.  To receive a paper report card in the mail, uncheck the box labeled “I only want to receive my child’s report card online, do not send me a printed report card”.  Then tap “Update” (mobile app) or “Update Account” (browser) at the top of the screen.  

Note: if “Update” is greyed out on the mobile app after unchecking the box, tap one of the other tabs at the top of the screen and then return to the “notify” tab.

Mobile App:

Browser:

4. A confirmation message will display, confirming that your changes have been saved.

Mobile App:

Browser:

Accessing Electronic Report Cards in ParentVue

Following the conclusion of each trimester, the Sherwood School District will post electronic report cards to ParentVUE for all students.  To access your student’s report card:

1. Sign into ParentVUE using either the mobile app or a browser.  If you do not have an account for ParentVUE, please contact the front office of your student’s school to obtain an activation key.

2. If you have multiple students, select the student for whom you wish to view a report card.

3. Tap “Report Card” on the menu.

Mobile App:

Browser:

4. If your student is in grades 6-12, select the desired term from the drop down.  If your student is in grades K-5, all available terms are displayed. Click the link at the top of the screen labeled “Click here to view report card” to open a PDF of your student’s report card.
